title: Securing the Skies: A Comprehensive Survey on Anti-UAV Methods, Benchmarking, and Future Directions
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW)
note: Best Paper Award, CVPR 2025 Anti-UAV Workshop
modality: Multi-modal survey (RGB, IR, audio, radar, RF)
ai_method: Survey: diffusion-based data synthesis, multi-modal fusion, vision-language models, self-supervised learning, RL
summary: Surveys anti-UAV classification, detection and tracking across single-modality and multi-sensor pipelines, and reviews large-scale and adversarial benchmarks. Identifies persistent gaps in real-time performance, stealth-target detection and swarm scenarios.

title: Deep learning for unmanned aerial vehicles detection: A review
ai_method: Review of deep-learning UAV detectors
summary: Review of deep-learning approaches to UAV detection. Abstract not retrieved during verification; metadata confirmed via Crossref.

title: A Survey on Detection, Classification, and Tracking of UAVs using Radar and Communications Systems
ai_method: Survey
summary: Survey of radar- and communications-system-based UAV detection, classification and tracking. Abstract not retrieved during verification; metadata confirmed via Crossref.

title: Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System(s) (C-UAS): State of the Art, Challenges, and Future Trends
venue: IEEE Aerospace and Electronic Systems Magazine
ai_method: Survey
summary: Defines C-UAS as systems that lawfully and safely disable, disrupt or seize control of UAS, and reviews detection, tracking, identification and mitigation technologies and their open challenges.

title: Defending Airports from UAS: A Survey on Cyber-Attacks and Counter-Drone Sensing Technologies
ai_method: Survey
summary: Surveys drone incidents near airports and the sensor technologies available to prevent, detect, identify and mitigate them, framed around critical-infrastructure protection.

title: Anti-UAV: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vision-Based UAV Tracking
note: arXiv preprint title: Anti-UAV: A Large Multi-Modal Benchmark for UAV Tracking
ai_method: Dual-flow semantic consistency (DFSC) tracker
summary: Introduces the Anti-UAV benchmark: more than 300 RGB/IR video pairs with over 580k manually annotated boxes, plus the DFSC tracker, which learns class-level semantics across sequences.

title: Anti-UAV410: A Thermal Infrared Benchmark and Customized Scheme for Tracking Drones in the Wild
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
ai_method: Siamese drone tracker (SiamDT), dual-semantic features
summary: Thermal-infrared-only tracking benchmark of 410 videos with over 438k annotated boxes, with the SiamDT tracker designed for small UAVs in dynamic background clutter.

title: CST Anti-UAV: A Thermal Infrared Benchmark for Tiny UAV Tracking in Complex Scenes
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW)
ai_method: Benchmark of 20 single-object trackers
summary: 220 thermal sequences with over 240k boxes and frame-level attribute labels, focused on tiny UAVs in complex scenes. The best tracker reaches only 35.92% state accuracy versus 67.69% on Anti-UAV410.

title: Air-to-Air Visual Detection of Micro-UAVs: An Experimental Evaluation of Deep Learning
ai_method: Evaluation of eight deep-learning detectors
summary: Introduces Det-Fly (more than 13,000 images of a target UAV taken from another flying UAV, varied backgrounds, angles, distances and lighting) and evaluates eight deep-learning detectors on it.

title: UETT4K Anti-UAV: A Large Scale 4K Benchmark Dataset for Vision-Based Drone Detection in High-Resolution Imagery
ai_method: Benchmark of eight YOLOv6v3 models
summary: 33,601 manually annotated 4K images from real-world drone videos in diverse conditions, used to train and compare eight YOLOv6v3 models.

title: Experimental study and evaluation of ground-to-air drone visual detection based on deep learning
ai_method: Deep-learning detector evaluation
summary: Experimental evaluation of deep-learning detectors for ground-to-air drone detection, the same camera geometry as this project's Case 1. Abstract not retrieved during verification; metadata confirmed via Crossref.

title: WRN-YOLO: An Improved YOLO for Drone Detection using Wide ResNet
venue: International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
ai_method: YOLO with a Wide ResNet backbone (via timm)
summary: Submission to the 8th WOSDETC Drone-vs-Bird Detection Challenge at IJCNN 2025 that swaps a Wide ResNet backbone into YOLO. Metadata from the authors' repository; DOI not located.

title: RFUAV: A Benchmark Dataset for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Detection and Identification
ai_method: RF drone fingerprint, baseline preprocessing and evaluation tools
summary: About 1.3 TB of raw RF recordings from 37 UAVs (the label set also includes RC transmitters) captured with a USRP, with tools to re-render data at different SNRs, an 'RF drone fingerprint' feature sequence and open evaluation tooling.

title: RF-based drone detection and identification using deep learning approaches: An initiative towards a large open source drone database
ai_method: Three DNN classifiers, 10-fold cross-validation
summary: Introduces the DroneRF database (drones recorded off, on and connected, hovering, flying and video recording). Accuracy falls as classes grow: 99.7% for detection (2 classes), 84.5% for drone type (4 classes), 46.8% for type plus flight mode (10 classes). Pre-2020, kept as the foundational open RF dataset.

title: DIAT-µSAT: Small Aerial Targets' Micro-Doppler Signatures and Their Classification Using CNN
venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters
ai_method: Transfer-learning DCNN (VGG16/VGG19 feature extractors)
summary: 4,849 micro-Doppler signature images of small aerial targets (rotors of different blade counts, a quadcopter, a bionic bird) from an X-band CW radar. Reports 95% (VGG16) and 97% (VGG19) classification accuracy.

title: Exploring Radar Micro-Doppler Signatures for Recognition of Drone Types
ai_method: Statistical signature measures (SNR, SCR, Doppler frequency difference, magnitude ratio)
summary: Compares micro-Doppler signals from puller and lifting blades across fixed-wing, multirotor and hybrid VTOL drones. Lifting-blade micro-Doppler is consistently stronger than puller-blade micro-Doppler, which matters for classifying drone type.

title: Audio-Based Drone Detection and Identification Using Deep Learning Techniques with Dataset Enhancement through Generative Adversarial Networks
ai_method: CNN, RNN and CRNN; GAN-generated audio augmentation
summary: Builds a hybrid acoustic dataset of recorded and GAN-generated drone audio and compares CNN, RNN and CRNN classifiers. GAN augmentation improves detection of new, unfamiliar drones.

title: A Tri-Modal Dataset and a Baseline System for Tracking Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
ai_method: Offset-guided adaptive alignment, adaptive dynamic fusion, event-enhanced association
summary: MM-UAV: 1,321 synchronised RGB/IR/event sequences, over 2.8M annotated frames, 30+ scenarios, for multi-modal multi-UAV tracking, with a baseline that aligns sensors, fuses modalities adaptively and uses event motion cues for association.

title: Fusion of Cellular ISAC and Passive RF Sensing for UAV Detection and Tracking
venue: IEEE Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers
modality: Passive RF (Keysight N6841A) + Ku-band radar (Fortem TrueView R20)
ai_method: Constant-velocity Kalman filter fusing asynchronous 2D RF and 3D radar
summary: Real-world AERPAW testbed experiments show radar and passive RF have complementary strengths across geometry, range and line of sight; the fused Kalman track suppresses large single-sensor errors and extends coverage.

title: Evidential Deep Learning for Multi-Modal Anti-UAV Detection
ai_method: Evidential deep learning, Dempster-Shafer fusion, temporal sensor gating (ablation)
summary: Controlled ablation on AntiUAV600, TRIDENT and MM-UAV. The evidential training objective improves accuracy (+5.9 and +4.8 points), but Dempster-Shafer fusion does not beat simple probability averaging and temporal gating gives no latency saving.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation
ai_method: Evidential fusion with discounted belief fusion (DBF)
summary: RGB-thermal fusion beats either stream on Anti-UAV (accuracy 0.670 vs 0.604 IR / 0.598 RGB) at 38+ FPS, with well-calibrated uncertainty (ECE 0.057). Conflict discounting is indistinguishable from plain averaging on this benchmark.

title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning in Time-Varying UAV Communications: Adaptive Anti-Jamming Channel Selection
ai_method: Meta-mean-field Q-learning; partially observable stochastic game
summary: Formulates anti-jamming channel selection for a multi-UAV network against a Markov jammer as a partially observable stochastic game, solved with meta-mean-field Q-learning for fast adaptation.

title: Deep Learning-Based GNSS Spoofing Attack Detection for Quadrotor UAV
ai_method: DNN residual prediction for spoofing detection
summary: Detects GNSS spoofing on a quadrotor by training a DNN to predict state-estimation residuals from onboard physical measurements and flagging deviations; validated in simulation.

title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
ai_method: NMS-free dual head, DFL-free regression, MuSGD, Progressive Loss, STAL
summary: Detection/segmentation/pose/OBB/classification family (n-x). Optional NMS-free one-to-one head, no DFL, MuSGD optimizer, and STAL label assignment that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. 40.9-57.5 COCO mAP at 1.7-11.8 ms on T4 TensorRT. AGPL-3.0 licensed.

title: DroneGround: Open-Vocabulary Drone Payload Characterization Using Synthetic Data and Grounded Vision-Language Models
venue: RVS-SE Workshop, British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) (accepted; arXiv preprint)
ai_method: YOLO26s drone localisation + LoRA-tuned PaliGemma VLM
summary: ~100,000 synthetic images (15 platforms, 6 payload categories, 5 bird species, 7 environments, 5 weather conditions). Two-stage payload characterisation raises F1 from 82.5% to 96.3% and reaches 80.4% F1 on unseen payloads (vs 42.7%). Data released on request only.

title: SimD3: A Synthetic drone Dataset with Payload and Bird Distractor Modeling for Robust Detection
ai_method: YOLOv5m with C3b attention blocks
summary: Synthetic drone dataset with heterogeneous payloads, bird distractors, and controlled weather and lighting. Evaluated in-domain, synthetic+real, and on unseen real benchmarks; the C3b variant outperforms baseline YOLOv5m throughout.

title: Neuromorphic Drone Detection: an Event-RGB Multimodal Approach
venue: European Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ECCV 2024, NeVi)
ai_method: Event-RGB fusion detector
summary: Fuses event and RGB streams for drone detection, and releases NeRDD: more than 3.5 hours of spatio-temporally synchronised, annotated event+RGB recordings (115 videos at 30 FPS).

title: Hazy Aware-YOLO: An Enhanced UAV Object Detection Model for Foggy Weather via Wavelet Convolution and Attention-Based Optimization
ai_method: YOLO11 + wavelet convolution + context-enhanced hybrid self-attention (CEHSA)
summary: Detects ground objects in foggy imagery taken FROM UAVs (not drones in the sky). Its fog-robust neck ideas transfer to Case 1; its reported accuracy does not.

title: Gamba: Marry Gaussian Splatting with Mamba for single view 3D reconstruction
ai_method: Mamba-based GambaFormer predicting 3D Gaussians
summary: Reconstructs a 3D Gaussian-splat asset from one object-centric image (trained on Objaverse) with linear-time Mamba sequence modelling. Not a range or depth estimator for distant targets.

title: GSGTrack: Gaussian Splatting-Guided Object Pose Tracking from RGB Videos
ai_method: Joint 3DGS geometry and 6-DoF pose optimisation with silhouette loss
summary: Tracks the 6-DoF pose of unknown objects from monocular RGB for robotic manipulation by jointly optimising a Gaussian-splat model and pose. Assumes the object fills a large part of the image.

title: TrackingMiM: Efficient Mamba-in-Mamba Serialization for Real-time UAV Object Tracking
ai_method: Nested (Mamba-in-Mamba) state-space scanning
summary: Real-time single-object tracking in UAV-captured video using a Mamba-in-Mamba design that respects temporal continuity. Evidence that SSM trackers can run in real time; not a drone-detection paper.

title: MambaSOD: Dual Mamba-Driven Cross-Modal Fusion Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection
ai_method: Dual Mamba feature extractors with cross-modal fusion
summary: RGB-D SALIENT object detection. Listed because earlier drafts of this compendium misread 'SOD' as small-object detection; it is not evidence about small-drone detection.

title: YOLOBirDrone: Dataset for Bird vs Drone Detection and Classification and a YOLO based enhanced learning architecture
ai_method: YOLO with adaptive layer aggregation and attention modules; bird vs drone detection
summary: Introduces BirDrone, 8,428 still images with bird and drone boxes collected in Chandigarh, India with a webcam and a phone camera; the study adds 3,067 frames from four Drone-vs-Bird videos (11,495 images, 13,881 drones, 15,867 birds). Most targets are medium or large (1,129 under 20x20 px). Reports detection accuracy of about 85%. The repository says the data is only partially available.

title: YOLOMG: Vision-based Drone-to-Drone Detection with Appearance and Pixel-Level Motion Fusion
ai_method: YOLOv5-based detector fed an RGB frame plus a motion difference map through a bimodal fusion module
summary: Fuses a pixel-level motion difference map with the RGB frame to find very small drones in clutter; introduces the ARD100 dataset (100 videos, 202,467 frames) and reports results above prior methods on ARD100 and NPS-Drones. Air-to-air (moving camera), abstract only read.

title: Real-Time Detection for Small UAVs: Combining YOLO and Multi-frame Motion Analysis
ai_method: YOLO with Ghost modules and attention, combined with template-matching multi-frame motion detection (GL-YOMO)
summary: Combines a YOLO detector with multi-frame motion detection for small UAVs at long range; evaluated on the authors' fixed-wing UAV dataset. Abstract only read.

title: Decoupling Ego-Motion from Target Dynamics via Dual-Interval Motion Cues for UAV Detection
ai_method: Homography motion compensation, motion cues at two frame intervals, motion-guided attention in the feature pyramid
summary: Compensates camera motion with a homography, extracts motion at two frame intervals and injects it into the feature pyramid by attention; reports consistent gains over a YOLOv8 baseline on VisDrone-VID. Abstract only read.

title: Improving Small Drone Detection Through Multi-Scale Processing and Data Augmentation
ai_method: YOLOv11 with multi-scale inference and prediction aggregation, copy-paste augmentation, frame-to-frame consistency post-processing
summary: First place in the 8th WOSDETC Drone-vs-Bird Detection Grand Challenge (IJCNN 2025). The gains come from multi-scale processing, copy-paste augmentation and a post-processing step that uses frame-to-frame consistency to recover missed detections, not from a new architecture. Abstract only read.

title: Sequence Models for Drone vs Bird Classification
ai_method: 3D CNN (R(2+1)D), LSTM and Transformer sequence classifiers over detection tracks
summary: Compares a 3D CNN, an LSTM and a Transformer for classifying detection tracks as drone or bird, on a new sequence dataset; sequence information raises bird-classification F1 by up to 73% and overall F1 by up to 35%, with R(2+1)D best. Abstract only read.

title: TransVisDrone: Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Vision-based Drone-to-Drone Detection in Aerial Videos
ai_method: CSPDarkNet-53 spatial features with a VideoSwin spatio-temporal transformer
summary: End-to-end drone-to-drone detector that learns spatio-temporal features over several frames; reported as deployable in real time on edge devices. Air-to-air, abstract only read.

title: Dogfight: Detecting Drones from Drones Videos
ai_method: Two-stage segmentation-based detection with spatio-temporal attention
summary: Two-stage segmentation-based approach using spatio-temporal attention cues for small, erratically moving drones filmed from other drones. Air-to-air, abstract only read.

title: Beyond Clear Skies: Synthetic Seasonal and Weather Variations for Real-World Drone Detection
ai_method: Game-engine synthetic images with rain, snow and fog (SynDroneVision-Weather) added to YOLO training
summary: Extends SynDroneVision with 55,187 annotated synthetic images of three urban environments under rain, snow and fog; adding them to synthetic drone-detection training reduces missed detections and false alarms on real benchmarks under adverse conditions. Abstract only read.

title: DINOv3
ai_method: Self-supervised vision transformer; Gram anchoring keeps dense feature maps from degrading in long training
summary: Self-supervised vision foundation model whose dense (per-patch) features stay high quality over long training through Gram anchoring. The arXiv record lists 26 authors (first five given here). Abstract only read; the abstract makes no detection claim.

title: Real-Time Object Detection Meets DINOv3
ai_method: DEIMv2: real-time DETR-style detector on DINOv3 features with a Spatial Tuning Adapter (HGNetv2 for the smallest models)
summary: Real-time detector family (X to Atto) that turns DINOv3's single-scale features into multi-scale ones with a Spatial Tuning Adapter. Reported COCO AP: 57.8 at 50.3 M parameters (X), 50.9 at 9.71 M (S), 38.5 at 1.5 M (Pico). Abstract only read; the code licence is unchecked.

title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers
ai_method: Lightweight detection transformer tuned per dataset by weight-sharing neural architecture search
summary: Specialist detection transformer that finds accuracy-latency trade-offs for a target dataset by weight-sharing architecture search, without retraining each configuration. Abstract only read.

title: A Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance for Tiny Object Detection
ai_method: Boxes modelled as 2-D Gaussians; their normalised Wasserstein distance replaces IoU
summary: Replaces IoU with the normalised Wasserstein distance between boxes modelled as 2-D Gaussians, because IoU is over-sensitive to pixel shifts on tiny objects. Abstract only read.

title: No More Strided Convolutions or Pooling: A New CNN Building Block for Low-Resolution Images and Small Objects
ai_method: SPD-Conv: space-to-depth followed by a non-strided convolution, replacing strided convolution and pooling
summary: Replaces strided convolutions and pooling with a space-to-depth layer plus a non-strided convolution, so fine detail is kept when downsampling low-resolution images and small objects. Abstract only read.

title: Fine-Tuning can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution
ai_method: Linear probing then fine-tuning (LP-FT)
summary: Full fine-tuning beats linear probing in distribution but can be worse out of distribution when pretrained features are good; probing first and then fine-tuning addresses it. Classification, not detection. Abstract only read.

title: XS-VID: An Extremely Small Video Object Detection Dataset
ai_method: YOLOFT: local feature association plus temporal motion features
summary: Aerial video dataset with eight categories and three size bands (under 12x12 px, 12-20 px, 20-32 px), and YOLOFT, which adds temporal motion features for small video objects. Filmed from the air, abstract only read.

title: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection
ai_method: Sliced inference and fine-tuning on image slices, on top of any detector
summary: Detects small objects by running the detector on overlapping slices and fine-tuning on slices; reports AP gains of 12.7% (FCOS), 13.4% (VFNet) and 14.5% (TOOD) cumulatively on VisDrone and xView. Abstract only read.

title: Scale Match for Tiny Person Detection
ai_method: Aligns object sizes of the pretraining dataset with the target dataset
summary: Argues that a size mismatch between the pretraining dataset and the target dataset degrades features for tiny objects (under 20 px) and aligns the two size distributions; introduces the TinyPerson benchmark. Abstract only read.

title: Augmentation for small object detection
ai_method: Oversampling images with small objects and copy-pasting small objects many times
summary: Attributes weak small-object detection to few images containing small objects and few small objects per image; oversampling and copy-pasting small objects gives a 7.1% relative gain on small-object detection on MS COCO over Mask R-CNN. Abstract only read.

title: TOOD: Task-aligned One-stage Object Detection
ai_method: Task Alignment Learning: sample assignment by a joint classification-localisation metric
summary: Introduces Task Alignment Learning, the sample-assignment scheme (a metric combining classification score and IoU) that Ultralytics' assigner descends from. Abstract only read.

title: LRDDv2: Enhanced Long-Range Drone Detection Dataset with Range Information and Comprehensive Real-World Challenges
ai_method: Dataset
summary: 39,516 annotated 1080p images of drones at long range, most with the drone at 50 pixels or fewer; over 8,000 images carry target range. The project page (2026-10-01) says access is on hold pending licence and access requirements. Abstract only read.

title: LRDDv3: High-Resolution Long-Range Drone Detection Dataset with Range Information and Thermal Data
ai_method: Dataset with YOLOv11m baselines at 640 and 1920 input
summary: 102,532 4K RGB images (5.7 h of video at 5 FPS, 128 clips, 17 days over 8 months) and 29,630 paired IR images; 93,652 drone, 6,031 bird and 722 airplane boxes; range for 101,227 images (0-200 m, most 0-50 m); boxes down to 12 pixels of area. The paper states CC BY 4.0, but the project page (2026-10-01) says access is on hold and names CDLA with a US export-regulation access condition; part of the footage is from a camera on another drone. YOLOv11m trained and tested on it reaches mAP50 0.543 at 640 input and 0.822 at 1920. No per-range or per-size breakdown. Full text read through an automated page summary.

title: SDD-YOLO: A Small-Target Detection Framework for Ground-to-Air Anti-UAV Surveillance with Edge-Efficient Deployment
ai_method: YOLO26-style detector (DFL-free, NMS-free, ProgLoss, STAL, MuSGD) with a P2 stride-4 head
summary: Ground-to-air small-drone detector that adds a P2 head to a YOLO26-style design; on its DroneSOD-30K dataset the n model reaches 86.0% mAP50, 7.8 points above YOLOv5n, at 226 FPS on an RTX 5090 and 35 FPS on a Xeon CPU. Abstract only read.

title: DroneDAR: Long-Range Drone Distance Estimation Using Monocular Vision and Bounding-Box Features
ai_method: CNN backbone on the crop gated with bounding-box geometry to regress range
summary: Estimates drone range from one camera by combining image-crop features with box geometry, and examines failure at long distance where the drone is a few pixels wide. The abstract gives no error figures. Abstract only read.

title: Drone vs. Bird Detection: Deep Learning Algorithms and Results from a Grand Challenge
ai_method: Review of three deep-learning entries to the 2020 Drone-vs-Bird challenge
summary: Compares three challenge entries; difficulty varies with the drone's size and shape visibility, and sequences from a moving camera and with very distant drones are the hardest. Each entry trades detection, false alarms and precision differently. Abstract only read.

title: Real-Time and Accurate Drone Detection in a Video with a Static Background
ai_method: Background subtraction for moving objects, then a CNN classifying each as drone, bird or background
summary: Two-stage detector for a static camera: a background-subtraction motion detector followed by a CNN classifier. Accuracy comparable to other approaches at high speed; its main stated limitation is dependence on the background being still. Abstract only read.

title: Distinguishing a Drone from Birds Based on Trajectory Movement and Deep Learning
ai_method: Bidirectional LSTM over trajectory coordinate sequences, trained on simulated tracks
summary: Classifies tracks as multicopter, fixed-wing UAV or bird from coordinates alone with a bidirectional LSTM, using a simulation pipeline for the training tracks; picks up differences in smoothness, turning and velocity fluctuation. Trained on synthetic trajectories. Abstract only read.

title: Event-based Tiny Object Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
ai_method: Event-camera dataset (EV-UAV) and a sparse segmentation network over the spatiotemporal event cloud
summary: EV-UAV: 147 event-camera sequences with over 2.3 million event-level annotations of UAVs averaging 6.8 x 5.4 pixels. Small moving targets form continuous curves in the event point cloud, which the proposed network exploits. Abstract only read.

title: MVA2023 Small Object Detection Challenge for Spotting Birds: Dataset, Methods, and Results
ai_method: Challenge report: 4K images of small birds; winners used ensembles, copy-paste, NWD loss, slicing and test-time augmentation
summary: SOD4SB: 39,070 4K images with 137,121 bird instances, 95% under 32 x 32 px. The baseline fell from AP50 46.4 on the public test to 15.4 on the private test; the winner (ensemble with copy-paste, NWD loss, SAHI, test-time augmentation, weighted box fusion) reached 30.3 on the private test. Full text read through an automated page summary.

title: MVA 2025 Small Multi-Object Tracking for Spotting Birds Challenge: Dataset, Methods, and Results
ai_method: Challenge report; SO-HOTA metric with Dot Distance in place of IoU
summary: SMOT4SB: 211 UAV video sequences, 108,192 annotated frames of very small birds, camera and targets both moving. Scores tracks with SO-HOTA, which uses Dot Distance because IoU breaks down for objects of a few dozen pixels. The arXiv record lists 24 authors. Abstract only read.

title: YOLOv8-SMOT: An Efficient and Robust Framework for Real-Time Small Object Tracking via Slice-Assisted Training and Adaptive Association
ai_method: Slice training (1280-px slices, 20% overlap) and appearance-free association: expanded-box IoU minus normalised distance, EMA velocity
summary: Winner of the MVA 2025 small-bird tracking challenge (SO-HOTA 55.2). Trains on deterministic overlapping slices; associates by motion alone, since appearance is unusable at a few dozen pixels, with boxes enlarged 2x before IoU and a centre-distance penalty. Full text read through an automated page summary.

title: Small Bird Detection using YOLOv7 with Test-Time Augmentation
ai_method: YOLOv7 with higher input resolution, multi-scale and flipped inference, weighted boxes fusion
summary: Development-category winner of the 2023 small-bird challenge: higher input resolution, multi-scale and flip test-time augmentation and weighted boxes fusion; AP50 73.2 on the public test and 27.2 on the private test. Abstract only read.

title: RFLA: Gaussian Receptive Field based Label Assignment for Tiny Object Detection
ai_method: Label assignment by a distance between the Gaussian receptive field and the ground truth, with hierarchical assignment
summary: Box- and centre-based label assignment leaves many tiny ground truths without positive samples; assigning by receptive-field distance balances learning for tiny objects, +4.0 AP on AI-TOD. Abstract only read.

title: DQ-DETR: DETR with Dynamic Query for Tiny Object Detection
ai_method: DETR with a counting module that sets the number and positions of object queries
summary: Adjusts the number and position of DETR queries from a predicted object count and density map; 30.2 mAP on AI-TOD-V2. Abstract only read.

title: QueryDet: Cascaded Sparse Query for Accelerating High-Resolution Small Object Detection
ai_method: Coarse locations of small objects on low-resolution features guide sparse computation on high-resolution features
summary: Finds where small objects may be on coarse features, then computes the high-resolution head only there: +2.0 mAP on small objects on COCO with high-resolution inference 3.0x faster, 2.3x on VisDrone. Abstract only read.

title: Towards Large-Scale Small Object Detection: Survey and Benchmarks
ai_method: Survey and two benchmarks (SODA-D driving, SODA-A aerial)
summary: Survey of small object detection; attributes the difficulty to poor visual appearance and noisy representation of small targets and to the lack of large datasets, and introduces SODA-D (24,828 images, 278,433 instances) and SODA-A (2,513 images, 872,069 instances). Abstract only read.

title: Dense Nested Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
ai_method: Dense nested interaction between high- and low-level features, with channel and spatial attention
summary: Pooling layers lose infrared small targets in deep layers; repeated interaction between high- and low-level features keeps them. Infrared, segmentation output. Abstract only read.

title: Solving Missing-Annotation Object Detection with Background Recalibration Loss
ai_method: Loss that re-weights background signals where an unlabeled object is likely
summary: When some objects are unlabeled they are trained as background; the loss recalibrates those signals for one-stage detectors and outperforms the baseline by a large margin. Abstract only read.

title: SparseDet: Improving Sparsely Annotated Object Detection with Pseudo-positive Mining
ai_method: Separates labeled, unlabeled and background regions; self-supervised loss on unlabeled regions
summary: Training with sparse annotations degrades detectors; treats labeled regions normally and applies a self-supervised loss to unlabeled ones instead of trusting noisy pseudo-labels. Abstract only read.

title: Benchmarking Robustness in Object Detection: Autonomous Driving when Winter is Coming
ai_method: Corruption benchmarks (Pascal-C, COCO-C, Cityscapes-C); stylised training images
summary: Standard detectors fall to 30-60% of their clean performance on corrupted images; stylising the training images gives a substantial robustness gain across corruption types and severities. Abstract only read.

title: PhysAug: A Physical-guided and Frequency-based Data Augmentation for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
ai_method: Frequency-spectrum perturbation modelled on atmospheric optics
summary: Simulates imaging degradations in the frequency domain to train a detector on one domain for unseen ones; +7.3% and +7.2% over the baseline on DWD and Cityscapes-C. Abstract only read.

title: Object-Aware Domain Generalization for Object Detection
ai_method: OA-Mix (multi-level transformations with object-aware mixing) and OA-Loss
summary: Augmentation that keeps object semantics while generating multi-domain data, with a loss for domain-invariant object and background representations; state of the art on single-domain generalisation benchmarks (AAAI-24). Abstract only read.

title: The Box Size Confidence Bias Harms Your Object Detector
ai_method: Histogram-binning calibration conditional on box size
summary: Detector confidence is biased with respect to box size, which provably harms expected performance; calibrating conditionally on size gains up to 0.6 mAP and 0.8 mAP50 with no extra data or training. Abstract only read.

title: Multivariate Confidence Calibration for Object Detection
ai_method: Calibration using box position and scale alongside the confidence; detection ECE
summary: Shows that detector miscalibration depends on box location and scale, and calibrates with the regression output as extra input. Abstract only read.

title: Do Open-Vocabulary Detectors Transfer to Aerial Imagery? A Comparative Evaluation
ai_method: Zero-shot benchmark of five open-vocabulary detectors on aerial images
summary: Zero-shot open-vocabulary detectors transfer poorly to aerial imagery: the best (OWLv2) reaches 27.6% F1 with a 69% false-positive rate; reducing the vocabulary from 80 to 3.2 classes improves results 15x. Abstract only read.

title: Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time
ai_method: Uniform and greedy averaging of the weights of models fine-tuned from one pretrained model
summary: Averaging the weights of several models fine-tuned from the same pretrained weights often improves accuracy and robustness, also out of distribution, at no extra inference or memory cost. Image classification; abstract only read.
